meta.title: {{name}}: online booking and management for service businesses
meta.description: {{name}} gives salons, clinics and barbers a 24/7 booking page, team calendar, client records and invoices. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

hero.eyebrow: For salons, clinics, studios and every business that takes appointments
hero.title: {{highlight}}, not your inbox.
hero.subtitle: Clients book themselves 24/7 from your own booking page, while your team calendar, client records and invoices stay in one place.
hero.note: No credit card needed · Set up in minutes
hero.illustration: Illustration: on a phone, a client picks a haircut and a 10:30 time and gets a booked confirmation, while the appointment appears in the team calendar.

who.title: Made for businesses that run on appointments
who.line: If customers book a time with you, {{name}} fits.

how.title: Up and running in an afternoon
how.subtitle: Three steps, no setup fees, no training needed.

setup.title: Set up services and hours
setup.body: Add what you offer, how long it takes, your prices and when each person works.

share.title: Share your booking link
share.body: Put your link on social media, Google or your website. Customers pick a time that is really free.

manage.title: Manage it all in one place
manage.body: See every booking, keep client notes and history, and send invoices from the same app.

features.title: Everything you need for the day-to-day
features.subtitle: Plain tools that do the job. Each plan shows exactly what it includes.

booking.title: 24/7 online booking page
booking.body: Customers book themselves day or night, without creating an account. They get a link to cancel or move their booking.

calendar.title: A calendar for your whole team
calendar.body: Day, week and list views for every staff member. Double bookings are blocked automatically.

clients.title: Client records
clients.body: Contact details, notes and full visit history for every client, searchable in seconds.

invoices.title: Invoices and payment tracking
invoices.body: Create invoices with your own numbering and tax, and record the payments you take.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: See your revenue and payments at a glance. Team and Business add deeper reports with exports.

website.title: Your own simple website and reviews
website.body: A clean page for your business with services, hours and reviews from real customers after their visit.

team.title: Roles, permissions and multiple locations
team.body: Give each person the access they need. Run several locations from one account on Business.

app.title: Install it like an app
app.body: Add it to your phone's home screen. Booking emails and push notifications keep everyone in the loop.

features.addons: Need more? Add packages and sessions, inventory, files and photos, forms and consent, or a client portal.

promise.isolated: Your data is isolated per business

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pick the plan that fits your team. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
pricing.fineprint: No credit card needed for the trial. Cancel by contacting us. Prices in USD, taxes may apply.
pricing.error: Prices could not be loaded right now.
pricing.errorHelp: You can still start your free trial, or write to us at {{email}}.

for.solo: For independent professionals who work alone.
for.team: For a small team sharing one location.
for.business: For growing businesses with several locations.

locations.perBranch: Multiple locations, each billed the same

feature.core: Calendar, clients, invoices and basic reports

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.subtitle: Extra modules you can add when you need them. Ask us to enable one for your business. Billed per business.
addons.name: Add-on

items.packages: Sell packages of sessions and track how many each client has left.
items.inventory: Keep track of retail and product stock, with low-stock alerts.
items.files_photos: Keep files and before/after photos on each client, stored privately.
items.forms_consent: Send intake and consent forms that clients sign online.
items.client_portal: Let clients sign in to see, move and book their appointments.
items.custom_roles: Create your own roles and choose exactly what each one can do.

trial.a: Yes. Every new business gets 14 days free with all features and add-ons switched on, so you can try everything before you choose a plan.

card.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
card.a: No. You only need an email address to start your trial.

cancel.a: To cancel, email us at {{email}}. You keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for. See our refund policy for details.

commission.q: Do you take a commission on my bookings?
commission.a: No. You pay a flat subscription. We never take a cut of what your customers pay you.

account.q: Do my customers need an account to book?
account.a: No. They choose a service and a time, leave their name and contact details, and get a link to cancel or reschedule.

countries.q: Which countries and currencies do you support?
countries.a: You can use it anywhere. Each location has its own currency, time zone and tax settings, so your prices and invoices match where you work. Our subscription prices are in USD.

plans.a: Yes. Just ask us at {{email}} and we will move you to another plan. If you move to a smaller plan, you first need to be within its staff and location limits.

support.a: Email us at {{email}} and we will get back to you.

cta.title: Ready to fill your calendar?
cta.body: Set up your booking page today. Free for 14 days, no credit card needed.

footer.tagline: Online booking and everyday management for service businesses.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.metaDescription: How trials, renewals, cancellations and refunds work for {{name}} subscriptions.
refund.intro: This policy explains how trials, renewals, cancellations and refunds work for {{name}} subscriptions.

trial.title: 1. Free trial
trial.body: Every new business gets a 14-day free trial. No payment details are needed to start it, and you are not charged during the trial.

renewal.title: 2. Automatic renewal
renewal.body: A paid subscription (monthly or yearly) renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel it.

cancel.title: 3. Cancelling
cancel.body: To cancel a plan or an add-on, email us at {{email}} and we will cancel it for you. After you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for, and you are not charged again.

refunds.title: 4. Refunds
refunds.body: We do not give refunds for partial periods, including unused time after you cancel, except where the law requires it.
refunds.errors: If you were charged in error or charged twice for the same period, tell us within 14 days of the charge and we will refund the incorrect amount.

reseller.title: 5. Who processes your payment
reseller.body: Subscriptions are sold and billed by {{reseller}} ("Polar"), our reseller and merchant of record. Polar takes your payment and appears on your receipt and bank statement. Send refund requests to us; any refund we approve under this policy is issued through Polar.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.body: For billing questions or refund requests, email us at {{email}}.
